note: site selector <-> plugin selector. The parity contract. Add a pair when a surface is ported.
expectedGapsNote: Entries whose GAP is a KNOWN, FILED deferral (it cannot be closed in CSS on the node this pair names). diff.mjs downgrades these to WARN instead of GAP, and REFUSES TO RUN unless every entry is named here with a workspace FOLLOWUPS.md number. Two shapes: a bare pair id (downgrades every rule on the pair) or "<pairId>:<rule>" (downgrades one rule; preferred). --- "featureblock:margin-top" / "featureblock:margin-bottom" (workspace FOLLOWUPS #39): the pair maps the site's INNER plate .md-typeset.fb (deliberately margin:0) to the plugin's OUTERMOST host [data-dse-element='featureblock'] (margin:0.5em = 8px), so the rule prints "site 0px, plugin 8px" and demands a shrink to 0 -- which is the wrong fix. The site's block rhythm lives on .fb-wrap (margin: 1.7rem auto = 34px at the site's 20px rem base, v2/docs/stylesheets/steel-featureblock.css:40), one level above the pair, so the real miss is 34px vs 8px in the OPPOSITE direction. Closing it needs new .sb-wrap/.fb-wrap pairs plus a live-site baseline regeneration -- a DOM-of-the-contract change, not a CSS one. NOT deferred, deliberately: statblock-band/featureblock-band margin-top (site 0px vs plugin -8px) stays a GAP -- the plugin band's negative pull only exists to cancel .dse-sb/.dse-fb's own plate padding, and that padding is itself on the worklist, so the two move together and Task 2 owns the decision. --- "section-head:ink" / "section-head:letter-spacing" / "pr-head:ink" (workspace FOLLOWUPS #40): these pairs map the plugin's title/header CONTENT node to the site's text-less flex WRAPPER (.sc-ability__section-head / .sc-ability__pr-head), which computes the inherited body ink and no tracking. The plugin's .dse-section__title IS the site's .tag (renderFeature emits no separate wrapper+tag): it is color var(--dse-metal-bright) = rgb(217,222,225) dark / rgb(44,51,56) light, EXACTLY the site tag's --fx-metal-bright (steel-ability-cards.css:186), and tracks 0.07em small-caps to the site tag's .1em -- so matching the wrapper's body ink / normal tracking would DE-match the site's real visible title and strip a deliberate small-caps treatment. Likewise .dse-pr__head is deliberately heading-emphasised (color var(--dse-heading)) to mirror the site's --sc-steel-lighter focus text (.chars, the roll readout), not the wrapper's body-ink default. The clean fix is to split the two pairs (add section-tag / pr-chars pairs comparing like-for-like) + a baseline regeneration, per FOLLOWUPS #40 -- a contract-DOM change, not a CSS one.

pairs.why: card plate: gradient + bevel + hairline. The plugin side is the HOST div — pipeline.ts stamps data-dse-element on the same root theme.ts stamps data-dse-theme on, and styles-source.css puts the plate there; .dse-feature is an inner content div with no plate.
flat right-rail slot: hairline + .35em radius + small-caps, no fill/shadow

statblock plate. The site plate is .md-typeset.sb (steel-statblock.css:76) — .sb-wrap is an unstyled positioning wrapper, so pairing it monitored nothing. Plugin plate is .dse-sb (the statblock host is deliberately transparent).
featureblock plate. The site plate is .md-typeset.fb (steel-featureblock.css:44) — .fb-wrap is an unstyled positioning wrapper. Plugin plate is the HOST div; .dse-fb is the inner content div.

reference-card plate (kit/condition/ancestry/treasure/... via CardLayout). The site node is the .sc-card tile (steel-redesign.css:159-166: --fx-card-bg + --fx-bevel + lift shadow + hairline); its field grammar (__head/__name/__type/__flavor/__stats/__body) is the same one DisplayCardView emits as __title/__subtitle/__badges/__flavor/__rows/__body. Verified against the live pages: the detail pages are NOT the counterpart — a kit detail page is one .sc-kit page-plate and condition/ancestry/treasure detail pages carry no sc- card node at all — so urls.json gained the kit index (tiles) + the perk index (the .sc-card--wide variant, which only re-lays-out the same plate).
